title: Local comparison of fan charts under a strict log morphism
statement: Let $f:(Y,N)\to(X,M)$ be a strict morphism of fs Zariski log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, lem-trf-log-fan-chart-blowup], and let $d:(Y,\overline N)\to G$ and $c:(X,\overline M)\to F$ be fan charts to fine fans [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. For each point $y\in Y$ there is a Zariski neighborhood $U$ of $y$, contained in the inverse images of the affine fan localizations $G_{d(y)}$ and $F_{c(f(y))}$, and an isomorphism of these localized fans $\lambda:G_{d(y)}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{c(f(y))}$, such that $c\circ f|_U=\lambda\circ d|_U$. Here $F_z$ denotes the affine open subfan of generalizations of $z$, whose sharp monoid of sections is $\mathcal P_{F,z}$. The induced map on monoids of sections is the map obtained from $\mathcal P_{F,c(f(y))}\simeq\overline M_{f(y)}\simeq\overline N_y\simeq\mathcal P_{G,d(y)}$.

proof.text: Obtain the section-normalized characteristic map g and its stalk bijections from lem-trf-strict-sharp-space-sections, using strictness and c.zariski. Bundle its sections and normalization as f.SharpSpaceMap.

Apply lem-trf-fine-fan-point-localization to c(f(y)) and d(y). Convert its normalization in original-open global sections into the required restricted-space normalization using colimit.ι_map, colimit.ι_pre and colimit.w for actual germs and open inclusion. This constructs L and K with precisely their original PointLocalization fields.

Use the chart stalk bijections and the bijections of g to form ac, af and ad as MulEquiv.ofBijective. Put alpha=ac.trans(af.trans(ad.symm)). The identity ad(ad.symm(af(ac(p))))=af(ac(p)) proves the prescribed normalized stalk equation. Bijective monoid maps are local via their actual inverse. The G chart also transports sharpness of G stalks to the source sharp-space stalks.

Compute sharp affine stalks using their equivalences with Associates of face localizations from lem-trf-affine-fan-localization-sections. Apply the third clause of lem-trf-affine-fan-hom-universal to alpha and its inverse. Its composition formula and the injectivity in the first clause show the resulting arrows are inverse, as complete sheafed-space maps. Conjugate this affine isomorphism by K.iso and L.iso.symm to define e. Functoriality of Gamma proves its required section identity.

The direct colimit proof of stalkMap_comp rewrites the prescribed alpha equation as the stalk comparison of h=g.map followed by c.map and k=d.map. Apply lem-trf-affine-open-germ-comparison to these local maps, the normalized affine opens, alpha and the already constructed e. Its U,a,b and full triangle/equality equations give every remaining clause; retain alpha and its two proven normalization equations.
